faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Bastar District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Bastar District Various Teaching and Instructor Posts is 07 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Bastar District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies for various Teaching and Instructor posts in the Bastar District Recruitment 2026. These include positions for High Class Teacher, Subject Expert, Integrated Teacher, Computer Instructor, Vocational Sewing Instructor, and Part-time Music Teacher.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Bastar District Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all posts is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for Bastar District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the Bastar District Recruitment 2026 notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Bastar District Recruitment 2026 will be based on merit determined by educational percentage marks, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary by post, ranging from Graduate with B.Ed./D.Ed. (VI) and RCI registration to M.A. in relevant subjects, PGDCA, 12th pass with ITI/Diploma, and 12th pass with a Diploma/Certificate in Music.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the posts ranges from ₹5,575/- for the Part-time Music Teacher to ₹15,000/- for High Class Teacher, Subject Expert, and Integrated Teacher positions.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Bastar District, which is https://bastar.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates along with the application form.
